verdict.rationale: The Kimi help center lists "定时任务" (scheduled tasks) among the assistant's general features, so this is a first-party scheduling capability. The only evidence is a single category heading, with no detail on recurrence, workflow chaining, or how jobs are configured. Missing for 10: documentation of recurring schedules (intervals/cron-style), scheduling of multi-step agent workflows, management/notification of job runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
